description:
Configuration for training hyperencoder models.

This replaces the hyperencoder/defaults/train_defaults.ini file
with a modern, type-safe, validated configuration system.

accum_batches.description: Number of batches for gradient accumulation
accum_batches.title: Accum Batches

ckpt_name.description: Specific checkpoint name to resume from
ckpt_name.title: Ckpt Name

ckpt_path.description: Trainer checkpoint file to restart training from
ckpt_path.title: Ckpt Path

dataset_config.description: Path to training dataset configuration file
dataset_config.title: Dataset Config

logger.description: Logger type to use for experiment tracking
logger.title: Logger

name.description: Name of the training run for logging and checkpointing
name.title: Name

num_nodes.description: Number of compute nodes to use for distributed training
num_nodes.title: Num Nodes

num_workers.description: Number of CPU workers for the DataLoader
num_workers.title: Num Workers

persistent_workers.description: Whether to keep DataLoader workers persistent between epochs
persistent_workers.title: Persistent Workers

pretrained_ckpt_path.description: Model checkpoint file to start new training run from
pretrained_ckpt_path.title: Pretrained Ckpt Path

pretransform_ckpt_path.description: Checkpoint path for the pretransform model if needed
pretransform_ckpt_path.title: Pretransform Ckpt Path

project.description: Project name for experiment tracking (e.g., WandB project)
project.title: Project

recover.description: Attempt to resume training from latest checkpoint
recover.title: Recover

remove_pretransform_weight_norm.description: Remove weight norm from the pretransform model
remove_pretransform_weight_norm.title: Remove Pretransform Weight Norm

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this training run
run_id.title: Run Id

save_dir.description: Directory to save checkpoints and model files
save_dir.title: Save Dir

save_top_k.description: Save top K model checkpoints (-1 for all)
save_top_k.title: Save Top K

val_dataset_config.description: Path to validation dataset configuration file
val_dataset_config.title: Val Dataset Config

val_every.description: Number of steps between validation runs (-1 to disable)
val_every.title: Val Every

title: TrainingConfig
